lines.text: You can actually live at the Plaza. Here's the bill.
Central Park out the window. Room service. Someone else makes the bed.
One standard room, one November night: about seventeen hundred dollars.
Taxes and fees push it past two thousand.
Book twenty-eight nights: sixty-six thousand dollars.
The median Manhattan rent? Forty-nine hundred a month.
A full year at the Plaza: over seven hundred thousand dollars.
One Plaza month covers thirteen people's rent. Would you check in?
